record.context_brief: Ampleness of the maximal abelian extension of Q
record.original_question: Is the maximal abelian extension Qab of the rational numbers Q an ample field, where a field K is called ample when every smooth K-curve with a K-rational point has infinitely many K-rational points, equivalently when K satisfies the other equivalent conditions listed in Proposition 2.1?

evidence.quote: An ample field is a field K that satisfies the equivalent conditions (1)-(4).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Call a field $K$ ample (also known as large or anti-Mordellic) if every smooth $K$-curve $C$ that has at least one $K$-rational point has infinitely many $K$-rational points. Equivalently, $K$ is ample if and only if $K$ is existentially closed in the Laurent series field $K((t))$.

Let $\mathbb{Q}^{\mathrm{ab}}$ denote the maximal abelian extension of the field $\mathbb{Q}$ of rational numbers, that is, the compositum inside a fixed algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbb{Q}}$ of all finite Galois extensions $L/\mathbb{Q}$ whose Galois group $\operatorname{Gal}(L/\mathbb{Q})$ is abelian. (By the Kronecker–Weber theorem, $\mathbb{Q}^{\mathrm{ab}}$ is the field obtained from $\mathbb{Q}$ by adjoining all roots of unity.)

Determine whether $\mathbb{Q}^{\mathrm{ab}}$ is an ample field.
artifact.status_search_result: Multiple sources on the theory of ample (large) fields, including Pop's surveys on large fields, list the question of whether $\mathbb{Q}^{\mathrm{ab}}$ (and the larger field $\mathbb{Q}^{\mathrm{solv}}$) is ample as an open problem. No proof or disproof appears in the literature available through the web search.

status_evidence.title: Little survey on large fields – Old & New (Florian Pop)
status_evidence.snippet: It is an open question whether the maximal abelian or maximal solvable extension of Q is large.
status_evidence.claim: The ampleness (largeness) of Q^ab is listed as an open question in Pop's survey on large fields.

status_evidence.title: Open Problems in the Theory of Ample Fields (arXiv:1106.1310)
status_evidence.claim: The problem is explicitly posed as an open question in the literature on ample fields.
